# Exodus: Sea of Signs — submission draft

Tiny 1v1 · standard dataset · Conquest · RMS + required XS · optional original audio

The sea is not a backdrop. It is a timetable both opponents can read.

Two oasis settlements face a broad, blue-green sea. Long coastal roads are available from the opening minute. Later, a public east wind draws the water curtains apart and exposes a shorter route. Both armies may cross. Ninety seconds before the waters return, everyone is warned. The exposed seabed then becomes a six-HP-per-second environmental hazard, while the coastal roads remain usable.

The landscape tells its story through burning bushes that survive their flames, moving pillars of cloud and fire, paired manna gardens and seven trumpet calls that collapse two ancient wall enclosures. The manna is gathered normally. The ruins already contain their gold and relics. Neither civilization receives divine favor or a secretly altered unit.

The authored terrain and resource positions are rotationally paired. Native starts, standard trainable units, civilization bonuses and Conquest remain intact. XS coordinates the event state machine, public timers, warnings, scenery, collision-safe barrier restoration, flood damage, resource-spawn transactions and bounded particle cleanup. Twelve original synthesized event/ambient audio cues accompany the signs without replacing the ordinary soundtrack. Custom audio acceptance is subject to organizer confirmation; the AI art study is not part of the playable submission.

This is a stylized biblical collage, drawing on Exodus 3, 13–16 and Joshua 6, not a claim to reconstruct one place or reproduce those passages literally. The sea uses fixed shallow terrain with animated Gaia scenery and barriers, not an undocumented live terrain-editing API.

**Before submitting:** add your contest handle, actual DE screenshots, engine build, seeds, multiplayer records and balance results. The current package is a newly authored, implemented playtest candidate; it must not be represented as in-game validated until `PLAYTEST.md` is completed. No contest submission has been made by this project.
